dimensions.assessment: Affects natural gas pipeline certificate applicants, associations, and persons asserting direct economic harm from pipeline approvals.
dimensions.evidence: filed not later than 180 days after the date of such approval by the applicant; or a person who has suffered... direct and irreparable economic harm

dimensions.assessment: Significantly restricts legal avenues by shortening filing windows, instituting a clear and convincing evidence standard of review, and granting original and exclusive jurisdiction to the D.C. Circuit.
dimensions.evidence: apply such subparagraph by substituting clear and convincing evidence for substantial evidence

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the source.
Amends Section 19 of the Natural Gas Act to alter judicial review standards, standing requirements, and court jurisdiction.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Natural Gas Act with respect to the judicial review of an application for a certificate of public convenience and necessity

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes to federal judicial review procedures for natural gas certificate applications.

missing_information: Any potential economic or market cost implications resulting from expedited pipeline reviews or restricted litigation.
importance_detail.rationale: Narrows judicial review timelines and venue for natural gas pipeline certificate approvals under the Natural Gas Act, altering legal challenges for applicants and affected parties.
